meta.name: add-vercel
meta.description: Add Vercel deployment capability to NanoClaw agents. Installs the Vercel CLI in agent containers and sets up OneCLI credential injection for api.vercel.com. Use when the user wants agents to deploy web applications to Vercel.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 让智能体把网站部署到 Vercel
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你想用智能体自动部署网站到 Vercel
copy.tagline_en: Let your agent deploy websites to Vercel
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want your agent to automatically deploy websites to Vercel

howto.what: Claude 会在 agent 容器里装上 Vercel CLI,并通过 OneCLI 为 api.vercel.com 注入凭证,让 agent 能把网页应用部署到 Vercel。过程中需要你粘贴一次自己的 Vercel 个人访问令牌。
howto.when: 当你希望 agent 把网页应用部署到 Vercel 时触发。前提是 OneCLI 已就绪,若缺失会提示你先运行 /init-onecli 再重试。

say.text: 帮我把这个网页应用部署到 Vercel 生产环境
把我的 Vercel 令牌配到 OneCLI 里
say.note: 创建名为 Vercel API Token 的密钥

say.text: 列出我在 Vercel 上的部署记录

howto.what_en: Claude installs the Vercel CLI in agent containers and configures OneCLI to inject credentials for api.vercel.com, so agents can deploy web apps to Vercel. You paste one Vercel personal access token.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you want an agent to deploy a web application to Vercel. Requires OneCLI to be running; if missing, it tells you to run /init-onecli first.

say_en.text: Deploy this web app to Vercel production
Set up my Vercel token in OneCLI
say_en.note: Creates a secret named Vercel API Token
